definitions.explanation: The relationship between time invested and results gained. Short for タイムパフォーマンス.

examples.japanese: タイパを{重視|じゅうし}して{倍速|ばいそく}で{動画|どうが}を{見|み}ます。
examples.english: I watch videos at double speed to prioritize time efficiency.

examples.japanese: この{方法|ほうほう}はタイパがいいです。
タイパを{考|かんが}えて{行動|こうどう}する{若者|わかもの}が{増|ふ}えています。
examples.english: More young people are acting with time efficiency in mind.

notes: A newer abbreviation modeled after コスパ, from タイムパフォーマンス (time performance). Gained popularity especially among younger generations in the 2020s. Reflects a cultural shift toward valuing efficiency in time use.
